description: MONITOR DA SECA is a series of datasets listed in Brazilian national spatial data infrastructure metadata catalogue (INDE), a metadata catalogue (CSW), published or maintained by Infraestrutura Nacional de Dados Espaciais (INDE). O Monitor de Secas é um processo de acompanhamento regular e periódico da situação da seca em vários Estados brasileiros (atualmente 12), cujos resultados consolidados são divulgados por meio do Mapa do Monitor de Secas ( Mensalmente informações sobre a situação de secas são disponibilizadas até o mês anterior, com indicadores que refletem o curto ... Coverage: Brasil. The portal lists 27 near-identical datasets in this series (one per year, month, area or site), grouped in this record; the first few are linked. Its tags are _2020_09_ms_es_epsg_31984, ES, features, MONITOR DA SECA, Espirito Santo. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support natural hazard exposure and risk studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-am-csw-inde-portal.
